title: Apple Display Coprocessor (DCP) XNU Boundary & Driver Interface Specification

xnu_drivers.role: Primary kernel driver binding to /arm-io/dcp. Coordinates ASCwrap-v6 mailbox transactions, DMA descriptor submissions, and VFTG timing transitions.
RTKit coprocessor life-cycle manager, responsible for Image4 firmware decompression, early boot staging, and panic telemetry extraction.
Exposes frame presentation tokens, VSYNC event mach ports, swap interval controls, and ProMotion dynamic refresh rate policies to WindowServer.

ipc_command_descriptors.name: dcp_cmd_SUBMIT_FRAME_SWAP
ipc_command_descriptors.description: Submits a new composited surface descriptor with DART DVAs, swap interval, and target VSYNC timestamp.

ipc_command_descriptors.name: dcp_cmd_SET_REFRESH_RATE_POLICY
ipc_command_descriptors.description: Configures SWMPR refresh rate constraints (e.g. clamp to 60Hz in Low Power Mode, lock 24Hz for media).

ipc_command_descriptors.name: dcp_cmd_UPDATE_CALIBRATION_LUT
ipc_command_descriptors.description: Transfers updated True Tone, ambient light, or 2D local tone mapping matrices into DCP staging DRAM.

ipc_command_descriptors.name: dcp_cmd_ENTER_AOD_MODE
ipc_command_descriptors.description: Transitions DCP into 1Hz Always-On Display mode and delegates frame pacing to Always-On Processor (AOP).
